root_cause: The prompt template used for the customer support bot lacked strict grounding instructions, and the model temperature was set to a high value of 0.8. Consequently, the model began fabricating discount codes and hallucinating competitor recommendations when asked ambiguous questions by users.
fix_applied: Updated the prompt template in `src/agent/prompts.py` to enforce strict grounding boundaries ('Answer ONLY based on the provided context...'). Adjusted the service configuration in `config/settings.yaml` to reduce the temperature parameter to 0.1 for customer-facing models.
outcome: Resolved. The RAGAS faithfulness score for response outputs recovered to an average of 0.94, and zero ungrounded claims have been flagged by the automated judge model in subsequent evaluation runs.
